items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: Yeah, I know him good. Oh, yeah, Alcibiad Jean-Jacques.

ctx.x: I know him but I can't think of who I was.
Did you ever know Alcibiad Jean-Jacques?
Huh? Did you know Alcibiad Jean-Jacques? He sure do. I do trumpet player. Oh, I see.
